loader_workaround: Process-local VK_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH selects an empty directory, bypassing stale TikTok overlay manifests. Registry unchanged; Khronos validation enabled for correctness.

archive_manifest.scope: Iteration-one source, reconstructed byte-for-byte against its recorded source hashes

baseline.graph_input_matching: Current src/bench.cpp compiled against archived runtime, public header and shaders; same command arguments and seed as candidate

retained_changes: Allocate/zero host results >=64 KiB after queue submit; always wait before propagating preparation exceptions
Locally close small independent components when exactly one oversized component remains and small nodes cover at least half the graph
Per-round changed flags; inspect final round rather than union of every round
Adaptive 8/16/32/64-round batches for sparse reachability active ranges <=65536 nodes; other solvers keep batches of eight
Shared-bank switching for local dominator matrices with 1024..4096 words
Versioned shader names for changed convergence and component-range interfaces
discarded_changes: Bank switching in local reachability: inconsistent paired timing
Bank switching in local liveness: inconsistent paired timing and outliers
Bank switching for dominator matrices below 1024 words: inconsistent paired timing

measurement_protocol.warm_scope: Host API wall time including allocation, upload, dispatch, convergence and readback; CPU reference generation/checking outside timing
measurement_protocol.interpretation: Speedup is ratio of pooled medians. Process-pair ratios expose between-process variability; no confidence claim or aggregate compiler speedup.
measurement_protocol.small_call_regressions: All 32 core rows preserved, including 1024-element scan 0.15675 -> 0.1612 ms and local liveness 0.1689 -> 0.183 ms. Unchanged-kernel timing fluctuations are not a new shader gain.

final_core_comparison.measurement: inclusive core API host wall time, warm calls; not compiler speedup
final_core_comparison.ordering: process order alternates by round and size; cold calls excluded from summary
